caption: Figure 1. The architecture of a Transformer layer and how neurons are sparsely activated in FC1 and FC2 layers due to the ReLU function. The neurons that are activated are represented as green rows or columns encircled by red lines. The output vector from FC1 is then supplied to FC2 as its input vec
